_note: Sample recipes written for the NutriMatch prototype. They are not copied from a published source, so source_url is null. Nutrition is not stored here: it is computed from ingredients in Phase 3. A null quantity means 'to taste' and is excluded from nutrition totals.

recipes.title: Classic Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo
recipes.description: The traditional rich version: butter, heavy cream and plenty of Parmesan over seared chicken.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water, then drain.

Season the chicken with half the salt and the pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken 6-7 minutes per side, until it reads 165°F (74°C) inside. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
In the same skillet over medium heat, melt the butter and cook the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the cream and the remaining salt. Simmer gently for 3-4 minutes until slightly thickened.
Turn the heat to low and stir in the Parmesan until smooth. Loosen with pasta water if needed.
Toss the fettuccine in the sauce and top with the sliced chicken.

recipes.title: Lighter Chicken Alfredo with Greek Yogurt
recipes.description: A milk-and-yogurt sauce replaces the cream, with broccoli cooked in the pasta water.
instructions: Cook the fettuccine in salted boiling water, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Cook in the olive oil over medium-high heat, 6-7 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C) inside. Rest, then slice.
Lower the heat to medium and cook the garlic for 1 minute. Whisk the cornstarch into the milk, pour it in, and simmer 2-3 minutes, stirring, until thickened.
Take the pan off the heat and let it cool for 1 minute, then stir in the yogurt and Parmesan. Adding the yogurt off the heat keeps it from curdling.
Toss the pasta and broccoli in the sauce, loosen with pasta water, and top with the chicken.

recipes.title: High-Protein Chicken Alfredo (Cottage Cheese Sauce)
recipes.description: Blended cottage cheese makes a creamy sauce, and there's extra chicken per portion.
instructions: Cook the fettuccine in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Cook in the olive oil over medium-high heat, 6-7 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C) inside. Rest, then slice.
Cook the garlic in the same pan for 1 minute, then scrape it into a blender with the cottage cheese, milk, Parmesan and nutmeg. Blend about 1 minute until completely smooth.
Return the sauce to the skillet over low heat and warm 2-3 minutes, stirring. Don't let it boil or it can turn grainy.
Toss the pasta in the sauce, loosen with pasta water, and top with the chicken.

recipes.title: One-Pan Chicken and Broccoli Alfredo
recipes.description: Pasta simmers right in broth and milk, so the starch thickens the sauce and there's one pan to wash.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Cook in the olive oil over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes until browned and 165°F (74°C) inside. Move to a plate.
Add the butter and garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute. Add the broth and milk and bring to a simmer.
Add the fettuccine and simmer uncovered for 12-14 minutes, stirring often, until nearly tender.
Add the broccoli and cook 3-4 minutes more, until the pasta is tender and the liquid has reduced to a sauce.
Take the pan off the heat, stir in the Parmesan, and return the chicken.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Alfredo Pasta Bake
recipes.description: Penne, chicken and spinach in a Parmesan white sauce, baked under mozzarella.
instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Cook the penne 2 minutes less than the package time, then drain.
Season and cook the chicken in the olive oil over medium-high heat until 165°F (74°C) inside, then cut into bite-size pieces.

Melt the butter over medium heat and cook the garlic for 1 minute. Whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the milk. Simmer 4-5 minutes until thickened, then stir in the Parmesan, salt and pepper.
Combine the pasta, chicken, spinach and sauce in a 9x13-inch baking dish and top with the mozzarella.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbling and golden.

recipes.title: Ground Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Weeknight tacos with a homemade spice blend, crisp lettuce and cheddar.
instructions: Brown the beef with the onion over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains. Drain excess fat.
Add the garlic, spices, salt and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the water and simmer 3-5 minutes until thick.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet, about 30 seconds per side.
Fill with the beef, lettuce, tomato and cheese. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
recipes.description: A quick vegan curry with tomatoes, light coconut milk and warm spices.
instructions: Heat the oil over medium heat and cook the onion for 5-6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk and salt. Simmer 12-15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Black Bean and Avocado Tacos
recipes.description: Spiced, half-mashed black beans with lime-dressed avocado and tomato.
instructions: Cook the garlic in the oil over medium heat for 30 seconds. Add the beans, cumin, chili powder, salt and water. Simmer 5 minutes, mashing about half the beans.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet.
Toss the avocado and tomato with the lime juice.
Fill the tortillas with beans and the avocado mixture, and top with cilantro.

recipes.title: Berry Greek Yogurt Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Five minutes of prep the night before. Needs at least 6 hours in the fridge.
instructions: Stir together the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, honey and vanilla.
Divide between two jars and top with the berries.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight.

recipes.title: Spinach and Feta Scrambled Eggs
recipes.description: Soft-scrambled eggs with wilted spinach and salty feta.
instructions: Whisk the eggs with the milk, pepper and salt.
Melt the butter over medium-low heat and wilt the spinach, about 1 minute.
Add the eggs and stir gently for 3-4 minutes until just set.
Take the pan off the heat and fold in the feta.

recipes.title: Turkey and Black Bean Chili
recipes.description: Lean ground turkey chili that holds up well for leftovers.
instructions: Heat the oil over medium-high heat and cook the turkey for 6-8 minutes until browned and no longer pink.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, broth and salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer partially covered for 25-30 minutes.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Lemon Salmon with Asparagus
recipes.description: Salmon and asparagus roasted together with garlic and lemon.
instructions: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the asparagus with 1 tbsp oil and half the salt and spread it on a sheet pan.
Nestle the salmon among the asparagus. Brush with the remaining oil mixed with the garlic, lemon zest, remaining salt and pepper.
Roast 12-15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily and reads 145°F (63°C).
Squeeze the lemon juice over before serving.

recipes.title: Garlic Shrimp and Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Shrimp, broccoli and bell pepper in a glossy soy-honey sauce.
instructions: Whisk together the soy sauce, honey, cornstarch and water.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the broccoli and pepper for 3-4 minutes.
Add the shrimp, garlic and ginger and stir-fry 2-3 minutes until the shrimp are pink and opaque.
Add the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy. Drizzle with sesame oil and top with green onion.

recipes.title: Lentil Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: Brown lentils, carrots and tomatoes, finished with spinach and lemon.
instructions: Heat the oil over medium heat and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 6-8 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 25-30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach, lemon juice and salt.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette
recipes.description: Romaine, cucumber and tomato with sliced grilled chicken and feta.
instructions: Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high. Brush the chicken with 1 tbsp oil, season with salt and pepper, and grill 5-7 minutes per side until 165°F (74°C) inside. Rest, then slice.
Whisk the remaining oil with the lemon juice, mustard, honey and a pinch of salt.
Toss the lettuce, cucumber and tomato with the dressing, then top with the chicken and feta.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Protein Smoothie
recipes.description: Greek yogurt and peanut butter make this a filling snack.

ingredients.notes: frozen in chunks for a thicker smoothie

instructions: Blend everything until smooth, about 1 minute.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Pan-crisped tofu with broccoli, pepper and carrot in a soy-maple glaze.
instructions: Toss the tofu cubes with the cornstarch.
Heat 1.5 tbsp oil over medium-high heat and fry the tofu 8-10 minutes, turning, until golden on all sides. Remove.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the broccoli, pepper and carrot for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the soy sauce, maple syrup and tofu. Toss for 1 minute.
Finish with sesame oil and green onion.

recipes.title: Vegetable Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: Best with day-old rice. Peas, carrot and scrambled egg.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high heat and scramble the eggs until just set. Remove.
Add the remaining oil, carrot and peas and stir-fry 2-3 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and stir-fry 3-4 minutes, breaking up clumps, until hot throughout.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, eggs and green onion and toss to combine.

recipes.title: Weeknight Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.description: A meat sauce built on onion, carrot and celery, simmered for 20 minutes.
instructions: Heat the oil over medium heat and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 6-7 minutes until soft.
Raise the heat, add the beef, and brown 6-8 minutes. Drain excess fat.
Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook 1-2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper and simmer 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti until al dente. Toss with the sauce and top with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Homemade Hummus and Veggie Plate
recipes.description: Smooth tahini hummus with raw vegetable sticks for dipping.
instructions: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt for 1 minute.
With the blender running, add the olive oil and water until smooth and creamy, 1-2 minutes.
Serve with the vegetable sticks.

recipes.title: Oat and Cottage Cheese Protein Pancakes
recipes.description: Blender pancakes made from oats, eggs and cottage cheese.
instructions: Blend the oats until floury. Add the cottage cheese, eggs, baking powder, vanilla and cinnamon and blend until smooth. Rest 5 minutes.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and lightly butter it.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter per pancake. Cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form, flip, and cook 1-2 minutes more.
Top with berries.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad Lettuce Wraps
recipes.description: Greek yogurt tuna salad with celery and lemon, served in romaine leaves.
instructions: Mix the tuna, yogurt, mayonnaise, mustard, celery, lemon juice and pepper.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves.
